body.label: Target
body.html: Self or an adjacent willing ally.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An area Action is declared including the target. Response (unopposed): Move the target up to 2 units along a clear path, then recheck whether it remains in the area.

surges.html: Ignore difficult terrain during this movement.
If still affected, reduce the Action's Damage to the target by 1.
